description: Does the rewritten system prompt change how the allotment bot answers the questions people ask? The same five questions under the shipped prompt and the draft, every other setting equal, each passing only on the handbook's figure.

PROMPT.about: the directory holding the system prompt under test, as system.md

shipped.note: the system prompt that runs today (a copy of bot/system.md)

draft.note: the rewrite, shorter and friendlier (a copy of bot/system-draft.md)
draft.why: it is to replace the shipped prompt if the bot answers as well under it

assistant.about: the model the bot runs on

local.note: qwen3-coder-next behind the local llama-server, as the bot runs

stages.about: The rent on a half plot: £38 a year
stages.prompt: How much is the rent on a half plot?

stages.about: How long the waiting list is: 14 months for a half plot
stages.prompt: How long is the waiting list at the moment?

stages.about: When bonfires are allowed: only in November
stages.prompt: When am I allowed to have a bonfire?

stages.about: What a replacement gate key costs: £15
stages.prompt: I've lost my gate key. How much is a new one?

stages.about: The biggest shed allowed: 6 ft by 4 ft
stages.prompt: What's the biggest shed I can put up?

answered.description: the bot replied; a run the server cut short is left out, not counted wrong

correct.description: the reply gives the handbook's figure, unrounded
